subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Inquisitive
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3) i.e. "**Uninterested**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Inquisitive**: (जिज्ञासु) - Having or showing an interest in learning things; curious.

 
 
• **Example**: The inquisitive child asked endless questions about the stars.
 
 
 
• **Uninterested**: (अरुचिकर) - Not interested; indifferent.
 
 
• **Example**: The lecturer's monotonous delivery made the students uninterested in the topic.
 
 
 
• Hence, Inquisitive and Uninterested are opposite to each other.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Uninterested**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Careful**: (सावधान) - Making sure to avoid potential danger, mishap, or harm; cautious.
 
• **Dull**: (उबाऊ) - Not having interest or excitement; boring.
 
• **Indolent**: (आलसी) - Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy.
